from fnmatch import fnmatch, fnmatchcase, translate, filter, filterfalse

def _t():
    import re
    assert translate('*') == '(?s:.*)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('*'), '(?s:.*)\\z')
    assert translate('?') == '(?s:.)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('?'), '(?s:.)\\z')
    assert translate('a?b*') == '(?s:a.b.*)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('a?b*'), '(?s:a.b.*)\\z')
    assert translate('[abc]') == '(?s:[abc])\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('[abc]'), '(?s:[abc])\\z')
    assert translate('[]]') == '(?s:[]])\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('[]]'), '(?s:[]])\\z')
    assert translate('[!x]') == '(?s:[^x])\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('[!x]'), '(?s:[^x])\\z')
    assert translate('[^x]') == '(?s:[\\^x])\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('[^x]'), '(?s:[\\^x])\\z')
    assert translate('[x') == '(?s:\\[x)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('[x'), '(?s:\\[x)\\z')
    assert translate('*.txt') == '(?s:.*\\.txt)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('*.txt'), '(?s:.*\\.txt)\\z')
    assert translate('*********') == '(?s:.*)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('*********'), '(?s:.*)\\z')
    assert translate('A*********') == '(?s:A.*)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('A*********'), '(?s:A.*)\\z')
    assert translate('*********A') == '(?s:.*A)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('*********A'), '(?s:.*A)\\z')
    assert translate('A*********?[?]?') == '(?s:A.*.[?].)\\z', ('assertEqual', translate('A*********?[?]?'), '(?s:A.*.[?].)\\z')
    t = translate('**a*a****a')
    assert t == '(?s:(?>.*?a)(?>.*?a).*a)\\z', ('assertEqual', t, '(?s:(?>.*?a)(?>.*?a).*a)\\z')
    r1 = translate('**a**a**a*')
    r2 = translate('**b**b**b*')
    r3 = translate('*c*c*c*')
    fatre = '|'.join([r1, r2, r3])
    assert re.match(fatre, 'abaccad'), ('assertTrue', re.match(fatre, 'abaccad'))
    assert re.match(fatre, 'abxbcab'), ('assertTrue', re.match(fatre, 'abxbcab'))
    assert re.match(fatre, 'cbabcaxc'), ('assertTrue', re.match(fatre, 'cbabcaxc'))
    assert not re.match(fatre, 'dabccbad'), ('assertFalse', re.match(fatre, 'dabccbad'))
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
